openings.claim: Can removable edge bearing meet the ten-cycle outcome under light seating while separating hatch friction from rim-jaw grip?
openings.delta: Use four supplied strips as two padded removable rim jaws. Change the lateral-load carrier from hatch friction to hatch-edge/strip/rim bearing. Compare stops engaged with stops clear under comparable light seating; cord recovers parts parked outside the full opening. Drill or cut only strips.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: light hatch friction already provides retention. Greater hatch displacement with stops clear than engaged, without jaw movement, supports a bearing contribution. Similar displacement is inconclusive; jaw movement defeats attribution. Two control closures cannot establish ten-cycle rival performance. Tight left-corner pressure and opposite-corner lift remain an alternative explanation if seating differs.
openings.probe: First inspect rim access and whether the same stock permits padded attachment, reversible stop clearance, comparable seating and exterior parking. If feasible, allocate two closure/pull trials to stops-clear screening, disturbing its second closure with the right-contact card. Reconfigure the same stock for stops engaged: ten opening/closure cycles, each with one 20 N pull, final closure disturbed. This uses twelve total closure/pull trials and one disturbed trial per configuration. Record marked-position displacement, jaw movement, corner lift, reopening time and visible tears. The engaged configuration must satisfy the full ten-cycle outcome; disturbed closures waive only seal continuity. Defeat: displacement over 1 mm, failure under 20 N, reopening over 30 seconds, tears, obstruction, unrecoverable parts, jaw slip, or inability to fabricate/test within 90/20 minutes. Incomparable seating defeats the mechanism comparison even if the joint passes.
assumptions: Rim geometry, adjustable stop clearance, strip stiffness, pad grip and release speed are unknown.
Twenty-minute observation capacity for twelve pulls, cycling and measurements is unestablished; stopping alone supplies no feasible informative test.

assessment: Hypothetical fabrication/probe only. Preserve every constraint; qualify only the engaged candidate after ten cycles. No deployment or performance is established.
